description:
At Elkins Leader Heads, we’ve proudly specialized in top-quality Aluminum, Copper, and Commercial gutter heads for over 25 years. As a leader in the industry, we are dedicated to providing products of unmatched durability and performance. We are thrilled to explore opportunities with potential affiliates who share our commitment to excellence.

Our 25 years of expertise translates into superior craftsmanship and innovative solutions that stand the test of time. Partner with us to offer your clients unparalleled quality and reliability, setting the standard in the industry.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Rate: Affiliates earn a 10% commission on the final sale whenever a customer makes a purchase through your affiliate link or uses your promotional code.
  • Payment Methods: Commissions are paid via PayPal, Venmo, or Cash App, depending on your preference.

Tracking and Reporting:

  • Dashboard Access: Affiliates receive access to a dedicated dashboard for real-time tracking of sales, commissions, and performance metrics.
  • Reporting Tools: Detailed reports and analytics are provided to help you optimize your promotional strategies and maximize earnings.

Additional Information:

  • Marketing Materials: We supply a variety of promotional assets including banners and product images to support your marketing efforts. Our team is also available to assist with custom materials or strategies if needed.
  • Program Policies: Our program features a 30 day cookie duration to track referrals, and commissions are paid on a Bi-Weekly basis.
  • Exclusive Offers: Affiliates will occasionaly have access to special promotions and offers to enhance sales and commission potential.

We are excited about the possibility of partnering with you and are here to support your success. If you have any questions or need further details, please don’t hesitate to contact us!
